item.title: StartUp Guide
item.description: StartUp Guide 1. Basics of Global Expansion $193 to register a US company + EIN + Stripe + Mercury Bank Step 1: Registering a US Company I chose to register in Wyoming because Wyoming does not charge corporate or personal income tax, and it allows registration by non-US residents. Visit Wyoming Agents Fill out the required basic information. For company type, select LLC for individuals or small organizations. If your company intends to raise funding, choose CORP.
